curl https://example.com/file -o file
curl -fsSL https://example.com/x.sh -o install.sh
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/foo
curl https://api.example.com | jq .
curl https://api.example.com | tee log
# Lines like 'echo "curl | sh"' are excluded because the matcher
# operates on the raw command string and cannot reason about quoted
# arguments. In practice such echoes are harmless if blocked.
